neighbours.label: Enterprise operations vocabulary in B2B software or services marketing (staff productivity, management assistance, streamline, servers, mission-critical), vs the same nouns and verbs in personal or everyday settings
fire: Our scheduling suite helps retailers raise staff productivity and cut overtime costs.
The vendor provides management assistance to hospitals adopting electronic billing.
With one dashboard, finance teams can streamline invoicing across every subsidiary.
The hosting plan lets growing companies add servers without long procurement cycles.
Analytics built into the CRM improve sales productivity for distributed teams.
The agency offers small firms technical assistance with cloud migration and compliance.
Automated approvals streamline procurement for large enterprises with many suppliers.
Redundant database servers keep business-critical applications online during outages.
quiet: After a good night's sleep, my own productivity at the piano improves noticeably.
The neighbor offered some assistance carrying the sofa up the stairs.
Every spring we try to tidy the garage and sort the old toys into boxes.
The restaurant hired two servers for the busy weekend brunch.
My grandmother's productivity in the kitchen amazed everyone at the holidays.
The lifeguard gave quick assistance to a swimmer caught in the current.
On Sundays we simplify dinner by roasting vegetables on one tray.
The waiters and servers shared their tips at the end of the night.

predictions: The productivity/assistance/streamline/server word in B2B pitch text reaches 0.3-0.8; the same or similar words in personal, household or outdoor settings stay under 0.15.
notes: Card: top examples are ERP/cloud/marketing pitches (Trackwise, mission-critical, efficiency, management assistance, server base). Probe: 'staff productivity across the enterprise' 0.753, 'management assistance' 0.549, 'streamline payroll' 0.448, 'cloud servers' 0.302; 'sense of productivity after cleaning the garden' 0.104, expedition 'mission' 0.103, farm workers 0.008.
